reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for guided setup across the CLI and the skill. CLI readiness: `init --json` returns a first `apps` gap (question message, technical.supported and technical.detected) when no agent app is connected and neither --apps nor the older per-piece flags were given; the answer, none included, is remembered in the state directory so the gap never returns; --apps installs hooks, the skill (global unless --skills-scope project, never asked) and Claude Code/Codex command approval without asking, and command approval also covers `notifai init` so reruns do not prompt. --wait (only with --json; otherwise a usage error) keeps a run watching the User’s step and adds top-level message (only when new for the setup run), waiting and stopped. The approval page and the already-connected phone page open in the browser except over SSH, with --no-open or with --approval notification; approval codes last 30 minutes and are extended with the same code while setup waits; an unextendable code is replaced ("That code expired. New one: …", named once); the 90-minute stop counts from when the approval began, kept with the saved handshake, and says "Tell me when you want to try again."; stop ("almost there") messages promise no test notification. After a browser approval setup opened, the phone message is "Now your phone: follow the page in your browser." with no store QR; the /setup/phone link, built by the protocol, carries the computer name for display. The test notification goes out at most once per computer and phone: the CLI asks GET /api/v1/machine/setup-notification and sends nothing when the browser or an earlier run already did, and retries a refused send once after the phone’s last_seen_at moves on. A terminal whose Companion App only waits on the plan moves on to the plan step; a terminal setup whose phone has notifications off ends with the same done content as --json. During init the hooks-trust state is an optional gap whose message is the done message’s short Codex /hooks warning; outside setup (doctor, a refused ask) the codex_hook_approval_required message names the same CODEX_HOME and turning the hooks on. Device nouns come from one helper (Android is "Android phone"). Notifai skill and harness setup: setup guidance runs one loop, notifai init --json --wait 240: send message whenever present (including with waiting: true), rerun at once on waiting, end the turn on stopped and finish on done, so agents never ask the User to report a step; the only question is which agent apps to connect, asked once from the apps gap and passed as --apps; the Claude Code and Codex command-approval sections and the Hermes skill line say command approval and the machine-wide skill come with the chosen apps. The approve-link, choices, claude-session and done-no-questions scripts are removed because setup’s own messages carry the code, link and per-app next steps; install, cloud, which-computer and installer-needs-you are shortened, and a done script remains for an older CLI, which is updated with notifai update or falls back to the earlier non-waiting loop. The QR stays in the conversation and never in a Notification Request. Domain terms: "Setup notification" and "Phone sign-in" name these concepts; User-facing copy keeps "test notification". Lifecycle hooks are unchanged. USAGE.md describes the new flow.
